user.title: Configure EV Charge Planner
user.description: Select the Home Assistant entities used as planner inputs. EV Charge Planner does not control a charger.

data_description.entity_prices: Select the Home Assistant sensor that provides the electricity price forecast.
data_description.entity_solcast_today: Select the Solcast sensor containing today's hourly PV forecast.

reconfigure.description: Wijzig de Home Assistant-entities die de planner als invoer gebruikt.

data_description.entity_prices: Selecteer de Home Assistant-sensor met de elektriciteitsprijsvoorspelling.
data_description.entity_solcast_today: Selecteer de Solcast-sensor met de voorspelling per uur voor vandaag.
data_description.entity_solcast_tomorrow: Selecteer de Solcast-sensor met de voorspelling per uur voor morgen.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one EV Charge Planner configuration is allowed.

data_description.entity_prices: Select the Home Assistant sensor that provides the electricity price forecast.

create_plan.name: Create plan
